teaser.en: An acacia with powdery green-white or orange bark, and on some trees, swollen ant galls that whistle in the wind.
teaser.sw: Mgunga wenye gome la unga-unga la kijani-nyeupe au la machungwa, na kwenye miti mingine, vivimbe vya sisimizi vinavyopiga mluzi upepo unapovuma.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa miya (*acacia*) wenye gopha renye unga, ra rangi ya chijani na nyereru au ya chungbwa. Kpwa mihi yanjina, miya iriyofutuka ambamo nkukala sisimizi inapiga milozi phepho richivuma.

summary.en: *Chigundi* is a thorny, flat-topped savanna acacia known for its powdery, coloured bark and fluffy yellow flowers. Across East Africa it gives firewood, fodder and an edible gum.
summary.sw: *Chigundi* ni mgunga wa nyika wenye miiba na kilele bapa, unaojulikana kwa gome lake la unga-unga lenye rangi na maua yake ya manjano yaliyo kama pamba. Kote Afrika Mashariki hutoa kuni, lishe ya mifugo na ulimbo unaoliwa.
summary.dg: *Chigundi* ni muhi wa miya wa herera, wa jenasi ya *Acacia*, wenye chitswa chibapa dzulu. Chinamanyikana kpwa gophare renye unga na rangi, na kpwa maruwage laini dza pamba ga rangi ya mandano. Kpwenye Afrika ya Mashariki yosi chinalavya kuni, chakurya cha mifugo na ulimbo unaoriwa.

about.en: *Acacia seyal* (now often called *Vachellia seyal*) is a thorny tree up to about 10 m tall with an open, flat crown when mature. Its bark is distinctive: powdery, greenish-white to pale green or orange-red. The straight white thorns grow in pairs and can reach 8 cm. In one variety some thorns swell at the base into hollow galls lived in by ants, and wind blowing across the holes makes them whistle. The fluffy flower balls are bright yellow and fragrant, and the pods are narrow, curved and light brown.
about.sw: *Acacia seyal* (ambao sasa mara nyingi huitwa *Vachellia seyal*) ni mti wenye miiba unaofikia urefu wa takriban m 10, wenye taji wazi na bapa unapokomaa. Gome lake ni la kipekee: la unga-unga, rangi ya kijani-nyeupe hadi kijani hafifu au machungwa-nyekundu. Miiba yake myeupe iliyonyooka huota kwa jozi na inaweza kufikia sm 8. Katika aina moja, baadhi ya miiba huvimba kwenye kitako na kuwa vivimbe vyenye uwazi ndani vinavyokaliwa na sisimizi, na upepo unapovuma kupita kwenye matundu yake hupiga mluzi. Vishada vya maua vilivyo kama mipira ya pamba ni vya manjano angavu na vyenye harufu nzuri, na maganda ni membamba, yaliyopinda na ya rangi ya hudhurungi hafifu.
about.dg: *Acacia seyal* (sambi mara nyinji unaihwa *Vachellia seyal*) ni muhi wa miya wa hadi mita 10 phephi, na uchikula unakala na chitswa chibapa na chiwazi. Gophare ni ra tafwauti: rina unga, na rangiye ni ya chijani na nyereru hadi chijani ngushu-ngushu, au ya chungbwa na kundu. Miyaye nyereru isiyomyoka inamera jozi-jozi na inaweza kufika sentimita 8. Kpwa aina mwenga, miya yanjina inafutuka kotsini na kukala na pango ndani, ambamo nkukala sisimizi; phepho richitsupa dzulu ya matundu gaga, miya inapiga milozi. Maruwage ni ga duara, laini dza pamba, ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala na genye arufu nono, na makakayage ni membamba, ganamyoka na ni ga rangi ya dongo ngushu-ngushu.

where.en: It is a typical savanna acacia, found widely from West Africa to Egypt and south to Zimbabwe. In Kenya it grows in bushed grassland and woodland, especially on seasonally flooded plains and black-cotton soils.
where.sw: Ni mgunga wa kawaida wa nyika, unaopatikana kwa wingi kuanzia Afrika Magharibi hadi Misri na kusini hadi Zimbabwe. Nchini Kenya huota katika nyika za nyasi zenye vichaka na misitu ya wazi, hasa kwenye tambarare zinazofurika kwa msimu na udongo wa pamba nyeusi (black-cotton).
where.dg: Ni muhi wa miya wa kawaida wa herera, unaophahikana hadi kure, kula Afrika ya Magharibi hadi Misiri, na kusini hadi Zimbabwe. Kpwa Kenya chinamera kpwenye nyasi zenye vitsaka na weruni wenye mihi, zaidi kpwenye herera zinazodzala madzi wakati wa mvula na kpwenye ulongo mwiru.

uses.en: ICRAF records that across Kenya the tree is used for firewood, charcoal, poles and posts, and its leaves, pods and flowers feed goats and camels. It produces a clear, edible gum that is sold, and its thorny branches make dead fences. Its bark has been used for medicine, tea, tannin and dye. Pakia records no Digo use.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaeleza kwamba kote Kenya mti huu hutumika kwa kuni, makaa, nguzo na milingoti, na majani, maganda na maua yake hulisha mbuzi na ngamia. Hutoa ulimbo safi unaoliwa ambao huuzwa, na matawi yake yenye miiba hutumika kutengenezea uzio wa matawi makavu. Gome lake limetumika kwa dawa, chai, utomvu wa kutia rangi ngozi (tannin) na rangi. Pakia hakuandika matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo.
uses.dg: ICRAF inaandika kukala kpwenye Kenya yosi muhi uhu nkuhumirwa kpwa kuni, makala, viguzo na nguzo, na makodzage, makakayage na maruwage nkurisa mbuzi na ngamia. Unalavya ulimbo wa kung'ala unaoriwa, ambao nkuguzwa, na pandaze zenye miya nkuhenda lichigo. Gophare rahumirwa kpwa dawa, chai, tanini na rangi. Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records *chigundi*, with the English names 'white galled acacia' and 'whistling thorn tree'. ICRAF gives the Swahili name *mgunga* and the English 'white-thorn acacia'. *Mgunga* is also the Digo name Pakia gives to another acacia, *Acacia stuhlmannii*. Mgombato has a similar name, *chigundi-gundi*, but for a different tree, the Egyptian thorn (*Acacia nilotica*).
names.sw: Pakia ameandika *chigundi*, pamoja na majina ya Kiingereza *white galled acacia* na *whistling thorn tree*. ICRAF inatoa jina la Kiswahili *mgunga* na la Kiingereza *white-thorn acacia*. *Mgunga* pia ni jina la Kidigo ambalo Pakia analitoa kwa mgunga mwingine, *Acacia stuhlmannii*. Mgombato ina jina linalofanana, *chigundi-gundi*, lakini kwa mti tofauti, *Egyptian thorn* (*Acacia nilotica*).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chigundi*, phamwenga na madzina ga Chingereza 'white galled acacia' na 'whistling thorn tree'. ICRAF inalavya dzina ra Chiswahili *mgunga* na ra Chingereza 'white-thorn acacia'. *Mgunga* piya ni dzina ra Chidigo ambaro Pakia anarihumira kpwa *acacia* yanjina, *Acacia stuhlmannii*. Mgombato ina dzina rinalohalana, *chigundi-gundi*, ela ni ra muhi wanjina, *Egyptian thorn* (*Acacia nilotica*).

reason.en: Coast whistling thorn, another gall acacia
reason.sw: Mgunga wa pwani unaopiga mluzi, mgunga mwingine wenye vivimbe
reason.dg: *Coast whistling thorn*, *acacia* yanjina yenye miya iriyofutuka

taxon.note: Acacia seyal is now Vachellia seyal
